title: D 3 Cone Agility Drill
description: A three-phase defense agility station built around three cones. Players first learn the footwork without a puck, then add puck control, and finally incorporate passing while moving through forward/backward transitions.
coaching_points: Use smooth pivots and stay low through every transition.
Explode backward off the outside edge after each pivot.
Keep one hand on the stick when skating backward and two hands when moving forward.
Add the puck and passes only after the footwork is clean.

title: 3 on 2 Corner Passer Cross Ice Game
description: A cross-ice game that begins with three players from each team, but one player per side becomes a stationary corner passer below the goal line. The live play becomes 2-on-2 and the attacking team must use its corner passer before it can score.
coaching_points: Defenders stay on the defensive side of the puck.
Transition quickly after turnovers.
Players without the puck move immediately into support space.
Corner passers decide where the next pass is going before receiving the puck.

title: Gates, Tires, Triangles Station
description: A creative puck-control station using three obstacle types. Players perform a 360 around single tires, figure eights through cone gates, and slide the puck under stick-and-tire triangles while moving freely through the area.
coaching_points: Keep the head up while navigating traffic and obstacles.
Use tight control turns around tires.
Complete full figure eights around cone gates.
Attack triangle obstacles with a controlled puck slide underneath the stick.

title: 1 vs 1 Bump and Drive to net
description: A 1-on-1 drill where the forward completes a sequence of passes and skating transitions before receiving a final puck outside the zone and attacking a defender who is trying to angle the rush away from the middle.
coaching_points: Forward keeps the feet moving and protects the puck with body position.
Once the forward gains the defender's outside shoulder, attack inside toward the net.
Defender takes a controlled angle and uses the stick to steer the rush outside.
Alternate repetitions from both sides.

title: Paint Scoring
description: A three-puck finishing station that challenges a player to score quickly using three different scoring actions: a backhand around an obstacle, a catch-and-release shot over traffic, and a forehand finish off a rebound-style puck.
coaching_points: React quickly to each new puck rather than admiring the previous shot.
Gather the first puck to the backhand while moving around the obstacle.
Open up immediately for the middle catch-and-release shot.
Finish the third puck while moving around the obstacle on the forehand.

title: Tricky Icky - Puck in Triangle
description: A puck-protection progression that develops tight control turns and body positioning. Players first learn the pattern without a puck, then add the puck, and finally work through a triangle-shaped route under pressure.
coaching_points: Lead tight control turns with the inside leg and trust the outside edge.
Keep the blade closed enough to keep the puck from sliding off.
Once position is gained, use the body to remove the defender's space.
Build from no-pressure repetitions to passive pressure.

title: Finders Keepers - Puck Protection Drill
description: A competitive puck-possession activity using fewer pucks than players. Players must find a loose puck, protect it in open ice, and look for opportunities to steal possession from others before the whistle.
coaching_points: Keep the head up to identify open ice and pressure.
Protect the puck toward space instead of skating into traffic.
Use body position before trying to steal another player's puck.
Play short rounds so intensity stays high.

title: Forwards / Backwards Chase - Puck Control Activity
description: A partner chase activity where one player skates backward and changes direction while the partner skates forward with a puck, trying to stay directly in front while maintaining control and awareness of surrounding traffic.
coaching_points: Both players keep their heads up because multiple pairs share the space.
Backward skater changes direction and speed to create separation.
Puck carrier stays balanced while matching those changes.
Switch roles every round.

title: 5 Pass 2 on 1
description: A full-ice, five-pass sequence that develops timing and puck movement before finishing with a 2-on-1 rush. Forwards use drop and cross-ice passes while defensemen participate in the passing pattern before defending the attack.
coaching_points: Call for every pass and present a clear target.
Place drop passes on the receiver's forehand.
Forwards time neutral-zone swings so they stay below the puck and skate into the pass.
Defender forces the puck carrier outside and protects the middle passing lane.

title: Forehand Shooting Fundamentals #3
description: A shooting fundamentals station where players transition backward to receive a pass, control the puck around a pad while skating backward, and then pull the puck into shooting position before releasing.
coaching_points: Keep the puck in a usable shooting position while skating backward.
Pull the puck toward the back of the stance before release.
Use a strong weight transfer through the shot.
Finish with weight on the foot closest to the net.
